category_title: Student with EBD who yells, throws objects, and wanders during instruction
minimal_context: Malcolm is assigned an independent math worksheet to complete by himself in the pull-out special education classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is your independent math worksheet. I need you to work on this by yourself for the next ten minutes while I sit at my desk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This is too hard! I'm not doing this stupid math.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to answer the questions on your own.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up and starts wandering around the classroom) I said I'm not doing it! You're ugly anyway!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please go back to your desk and keep trying.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Yells loudly, throws the pencil across the room, and drops to roll on the floor) No! I'm not doing it!
